description: Continue editing the LAST image that was generated or edited in this session, optionally using additional reference images. Use this for iterative improvements.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio of the output image. Omit to let the model choose: new images usually come out landscape (about 16:9) and edits keep the source image's shape. Pass "1:1" for a square image.

imageSize.description: Resolution of the output image. Default: "1K". Use "2K" or "4K" for high-resolution output.

model.description: Model to use. "gemini-nano-banana-2.1" (default, Nano Banana 2.1 — pro quality at Flash speed), "gemini-3.1-flash-image" (Nano Banana 2, previous default), "gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image" (Nano Banana 2 Lite — fastest and cheapest, 1K output only), "gemini-2.5-flash-image" (legacy fast), or "gemini-3-pro-image" (Nano Banana Pro, highest quality)

prompt.description: Text describing the modifications to make to the last image

referenceImages.description: Optional array of file paths to additional reference images

thinkingLevel.description: How much the model reasons before drawing. "minimal" is fastest and cheapest; "high" is best for complex prompts (infographics, text in images, several consistent characters). Default: the model's own ("medium" on "gemini-nano-banana-2.1"). "gemini-3.1-flash-image" and "gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image" accept only "minimal" or "high"; "gemini-2.5-flash-image" does not support thinking levels.

useGoogleSearch.description: Enable Google Search grounding for fact-aware image generation. Only supported on "gemini-3-pro-image".

name: continue_editing
